  "categories": [

      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/base.cpp, and src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to allow txindex operation on pruned nodes and track starting sync height.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables txindex on pruned nodes, removing a long-standing constraint where block pruning and transaction indexing were mutually exclusive. As described in the PR, index entries now reference block hashes instead of disk file offsets, allowing pruned nodes to index transactions without retaining full historical block data on disk."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, and src/rest.cpp to handle lookups for transactions located in pruned blocks.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Updates RPC and REST endpoints to return candidate block hashes when querying transactions in pruned blocks, enabling clients to fetch the necessary blocks via getblockfrompeer. Reviewers note an open interface concern regarding whether block hashes should be structured data rather than embedded in error strings."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test_runner.py only to register the new functional test feature_txindex_prune.py.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes to test runner and tests specifically validate txindex functionality and do not alter shared testing infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp solely to remove the startup check asserting pruning is incompatible with txindex.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The init change is purely a mechanical relaxation of configuration validation required by the txindex feature."
    }
